google play: An explicit Google Play app-store merchant charge. Google Pay is a payment method and is not Google Play. A shop paid with Google Pay belongs to the shop's category.
google one: An explicit Google One storage-service charge. Google Pay wallet payments and Google Play alone do not identify Google One.
transport: Public transport, fares and returned transit-card balances, including OVpay and OV-chipkaart. Not internet bills or travel-retail shopping.
vue movie pass: Explicit Vue moviepas/movie-pass recurring invoice. Not an ordinary Vue cinema merchant charge without pass evidence.
other internet bill: Payment for internet access from a telecom provider. A URL, online purchase, app store or marketplace alone is not evidence.
internet: An explicit internet-access bill or a shared internet-bill repayment.
other phone bill: Mobile/telephone service from a provider such as Lebara or Pildyk. An incoming bank-card top-up or returned transit-card balance is not phone service.
revpoints: Purchase of Revolut loyalty points, including RevPoints Spare Change. Not an internal transfer or a savings deposit.
revolut: Revolut account funding or bank movement. Not RevPoints purchases; use a more specific purpose when stated.
money transfer: Explicit account funding or money movement without an identified purchase purpose. Not ordinary retail spending or a named shared purchase.
account top-up: Incoming funding of a bank/payment account by a payment card. Not a phone recharge, salary or a purchase.
cash: Actual cash withdrawal or cash account movement. Not a fallback for a named shop purchase or a repayment.
credit card: Payment or settlement of a credit-card account; not the purpose of the underlying purchases.
klarna: Klarna payment with no more specific purchase purpose stated. If the memo names airline tickets, use Flights/Travel instead.
investments: Investment purchases or movement into/out of an investment account. Not consumption spending or drinks.
subscriptions: An explicitly recurring service. A merchant name alone does not establish recurrence; prefer a specific supported merchant/purpose.
income: Income earned or received, excluding account funding, refunds, returned balances, reimbursements and savings movements.
